releases.name: SpikyMC 1.2.0
releases.body:
### Added
- A search box in the settings window filters every option and section by name, so you no longer have to remember which page a setting lives on.

releases.name: SpikyMC 1.1.1
releases.body:
### Fixed
- Sign-in with Ely.by via the button now works on every build. Non-portable builds previously sent an incorrect callback, which Ely.by does not accept.

releases.name: SpikyMC 1.1.0
releases.body:
### Added
- Ely.by accounts: sign in with an Ely.by account, with custom skins and support for servers that only allow Ely.by
- Ely.by game patch: automatic download and application of the Ely.by patch (always / for Ely.by or offline accounts / for Ely.by accounts only / never)

### Changed
- Offline accounts accept any nickname, with no length/charset validation and no "allow invalid usernames" toggle

### Fixed
- Localization
- Issues from previous versions

### Known Issues
- Sign-in with Ely.by via the button is broken in the non-portable builds, but signing in with a code still works.
  **Workaround:** use https://account.ely.by/code.
  The portable builds are unaffected. Fixed in 1.1.1.

releases.name: SpikyMC 1.0.0
releases.body:
First stable release. All core features are in place.

### Added
- Offline accounts
- Custom theme
- Custom icon set

### Fixed
- Issues from previous versions
